name: paper-shift
description: Translate extractable English text in research PDFs into Japanese while retaining page geometry and references.

interface.longDescription: Translate extractable English text in research PDFs into Japanese while keeping page geometry, images, and references where possible. Requires a Python execution environment with PyMuPDF; scanned PDFs are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Translate my attached English research paper PDF into Japanese and give me the PDF.
